chunks: As for what is in it from Abū Maryam al-Anṣārī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Abū Maryam.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, from whom the author reports in this chain
key_terms.أَبِي مَرْيَمَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ: Abū Maryam al-Anṣārī, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating direct authorial transmission

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū Maryam al-Anṣārī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Abū Maryam al-Anṣārī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for tracing and evaluating reports.
